experiment.description: Olmix policies fitted with the reference per-task log-linear law on the frozen 280-run Qwen3 3e18 swarm (Huber 0.01, 48 starts, seed 0) and solved with Olmix's exact capped KL proposer (cap 4), trained at 3e18 on v6e-8: Uncheatable KL 0.05 and 0.1 at data seed 666200 with trainer seeds 0/1/2 plus a single KL 0 run; suite KL 0.005 at data seed 662009 with trainer seeds 0/1/2 plus a single KL 0 run. Eleven runs. Purpose: the paper's trained Olmix comparators were fitted in June/July on Llama 200M/6B data (Uncheatable with one aggregate head), so Table 1 conflates surrogate and fitting data; this gives a matched comparison. Approved by Calvin 2026-09-08 ~14:05 PDT.
